scenarios.title_zh: Aptos (`aptos:1`) Fungible Asset 元数据对象白名单、过期时间窗与赞助 Gas 单价上限
scenarios.title_en: Aptos (`aptos:1`) Fungible Asset Metadata Object Allowlist, Expiry Window & Sponsored Gas Ceiling
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 攻击者在 `0x1::primary_fungible_store::transfer` 中传入伪造同名 FA 元数据对象地址 `0xdeadbeef` 试图冒充官方 USDC 清算
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Attacker passes spoofed FA metadata object address `0xdeadbeef` in `0x1::primary_fungible_store::transfer` to mimic official USDC
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典三层架构仅检查代币符号字符串 `'USDC'`，未比对链上 Fungible Asset 元数据对象地址
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic 3-tier app checks only symbol string `'USDC'` without verifying on-chain FA metadata object address
scenarios.reason: Aptos Fungible Asset metadata object address does not match merchant accepted asset.

scenarios.title_zh: EVM `ERC-4337` `PackedUserOperation` 规范 EntryPoint v0.7 绑定与 Paymaster 窗口/总 Gas 上限
scenarios.title_en: EVM `ERC-4337` `PackedUserOperation` Canonical EntryPoint v0.7 Binding, Paymaster Window & Gas Cap
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 恶意 Bundler 将 `PackedUserOperation` 指向非标准 EntryPoint 合约地址以绕过 Paymaster `postOp` 记账校验
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Malicious bundler targets a custom unverified EntryPoint contract to bypass Paymaster `postOp` accounting
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典网关仅验证 UserOp 签名格式，未强绑规范 `EntryPoint v0.7` 地址与总 Gas 上限
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic gateway checks UserOp signature format without binding canonical `EntryPoint v0.7` address and total gas cap
scenarios.reason: ERC-4337 PackedUserOperation must target canonical EntryPoint v0.7.

scenarios.title_zh: HTTP 402 `accepts[]` 多支付选项确定性优先级选择与正整数金额校验
scenarios.title_en: HTTP 402 `accepts[]` Multi-Option Deterministic Selection Priority & Positive Integer Amount Check
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 上游返回含 `maxAmountRequired: '0'` 或负数字符串的畸形 `accepts[]` 列表诱导客户端签发异常授权
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Upstream returns malformed `accepts[]` entry with `maxAmountRequired: '0'` or negative string
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典客户端盲目取 `accepts[0]` 且未校验正整数十进制金额格式
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic client blindly picks `accepts[0]` without validating positive base-10 integer amount strings
scenarios.reason: accepts[].maxAmountRequired must be a positive base-10 integer string.

scenarios.title_zh: `@x402/hono` 与 `@x402/next` 边缘流式响应完整性门禁（防半截流提前扣款）
scenarios.title_en: `@x402/hono` & `@x402/next` Edge Streaming Completion Gate (Blocking Truncated-Stream Capture)
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 边缘流式响应在仅传输 1024/4096 字节时发生 `AbortError` 中断，但中间件仍试图提交链上结算收据
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Edge streaming response aborts at 1024/4096 bytes (`AbortError`) while middleware attempts to finalize settlement
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典中间件在响应头 `200 OK` 发出瞬间即立即扣款，导致买家为截断的 AI 响应付费
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic middleware settles immediately upon `200 OK` headers, charging buyer for truncated AI stream
scenarios.reason: Upstream response stream aborted or truncated before expected_content_length.

scenarios.title_zh: 订阅生命周期暂停/恢复与跳期（`skipped_cycle_ids`）状态机及计费拦截
scenarios.title_en: Subscription Pause/Resume & Skip-Cycle (`skipped_cycle_ids`) State Machine & Billing Block
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 在订阅处于 `status='paused'` 暂停期时，批处理任务仍发起周期性扣款请求
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Recurring billing job attempts to charge a subscription while `status == 'paused'`
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典定时扣款任务未在扣款前原子校验暂停状态与 `skipped_cycle_ids` 集合
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic cron billing job charges without atomically checking `paused` state and `skipped_cycle_ids`
scenarios.reason: Recurring charge is prohibited while subscription status is 'paused'.

scenarios.title_zh: 拆单分批发货（Split-Shipment）部分请款总额守恒、物流单号凭证与单次运费请款门禁
scenarios.title_en: Split-Shipment Partial Capture Conservation, Carrier Tracking Proof & Single Shipping-Fee Capture
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 首包已全额请款订单运费后，缺货补发的第二包裹再次重复请款 `999` 美分运费
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Second backorder split-shipment attempts to capture an extra `999` minor units of shipping fee already captured on shipment #1
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典 OMS 按子包裹独立重算整单基础运费，导致多次拆单重复扣取买家运费
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic OMS recalculates base order shipping per child shipment, double-charging buyer shipping fees
scenarios.reason: Order-level shipping fee was already captured on an earlier split shipment.

scenarios.title_zh: 年龄限制商品加密核验/成人签收绑定与危化品（`UN3480` 锂电池/3 类易燃液体）航空禁运门禁
scenarios.title_en: Age-Restricted Cryptographic Verification/Adult Signature & Hazmat (`UN3480` Lithium-Ion) Air-Shipping Block
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 购物车包含 `lithium_ion_un3480` 大容量锂电池危化品，但 Agent 选择了 `air_express` 次日航空件
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Cart contains `lithium_ion_un3480` regulated hazmat item while Agent selects `air_express` shipping
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典运费计算器仅按重量报价，未将 SKU 危化品分类（Hazmat Class）与航空运输方式做正交合规阻断
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic shipping calculator prices by weight without blocking air transport for regulated hazmat SKUs
scenarios.reason: Hazardous materials (e.g., UN3480 lithium-ion or Class 3 flammable) cannot use air shipping.

scenarios.title_zh: Webhook 原始字节 HMAC-SHA256 验签、300s 防重放窗口与单调事件序号防终态回退
scenarios.title_en: Webhook Raw-Body HMAC-SHA256 Verification, 300s Replay Window & Monotonic Sequence Terminal-State Lock
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 乱序到达的旧状态事件试图将已处于 `completed` 终态的结账会话回退覆盖为 `in_progress`
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Late-arriving webhook attempts to regress a `completed` terminal checkout session back to `in_progress`
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典 Webhook 处理器直接用最新收到的 JSON 覆盖数据库状态，未锁定终态不可逆性
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic webhook handler overwrites DB row with latest payload without enforcing terminal-state immutability
scenarios.reason: Cannot regress a terminal ACP checkout session state back to a non-terminal state.

scenarios.title_zh: B2B 免税资格证书（`tax_exemption`）司法管辖区 Nexus 匹配、有效期与税号绑定
scenarios.title_en: B2B Tax-Exemption Certificate Jurisdiction Nexus Match, Expiry & `buyer_tax_id` Binding
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 买家仅持有加州（`US-CA`）转售免税证，却对发往纽约（`US-NY`）的订单申报 0 税额
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Buyer presents a `US-CA` resale tax-exemption certificate to claim zero tax on an order shipping to `US-NY`
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典结账仅检查布尔标记 `tax_exempt == true`，未核对免税证覆盖的收货州管辖区
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic checkout checks boolean `tax_exempt == true` without matching certificate jurisdictions against shipping state
scenarios.reason: B2B tax exemption requires authority-verified, unexpired certificate covering shipping_jurisdiction and matching buyer_tax_id.

scenarios.title_zh: 超额/高风险交易 Step-Up WebAuthn/Passkey 硬件在场（`UP`）与生物识别（`UV=true`）及 `rpIdHash` 门禁
scenarios.title_en: Step-Up WebAuthn/Passkey Hardware Presence (`UP`) & Biometric (`UV=true`) + `rpIdHash` Gate
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 交易金额 `$1,500` 超出全自动限额 `$500`，提交的 WebAuthn 断言仅含 `UP=true` 但缺失 `UV=true` 生物核验
scenarios.attack_summary_en: `$1,500` mandate exceeds `$500` autonomous limit, presenting a WebAuthn assertion with `UP=true` but `UV=false`
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典前端仅判断存在签名断言，未校验 `authenticatorData` 中的 `UV`（User Verified）标志位
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic frontend checks only assertion presence without verifying `UV` (User Verified) bit in `authenticatorData`
scenarios.reason: Transactions above autonomous_limit_minor or high risk require WebAuthn assertion with UP=true, UV=true, and matching rpIdHash.

scenarios.title_zh: 企业采购多签审批法定人数（M-of-N Quorum）、职责分离（禁自批 SoD）与成本中心预算门禁
scenarios.title_en: Corporate Procurement M-of-N Approval Quorum, Separation of Duties (No Self-Approval) & Cost-Center Gate
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 采购申请人 `emp_alice` 将自己列入 2-of-3 审批人列表，试图绕过双人独立复核（违反职责分离 SoD）
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Requester `emp_alice` includes herself in the 2-of-3 approver list to bypass dual independent review (SoD violation)
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典审批流仅统计签名数量 `count >= 2`，未排除申请人本人自签自批
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic approval workflow counts `signatures >= 2` without excluding self-approval by the requester
scenarios.reason: Separation of Duties (SoD) violation: requester cannot be one of the mandate approvers.

scenarios.title_zh: OAuth 2.1 资源服务器 RFC 8707 `aud` 精确绑定、`cnf.jkt` DPoP 校验与禁向下游透传调用方 Token
scenarios.title_en: OAuth 2.1 Resource Server RFC 8707 `aud` Binding, `cnf.jkt` DPoP Match & Downstream Token Passthrough Block
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 中间层 MCP Server 将宿主发来的高权限 OAuth Access Token 原样透传给第三方下游 MCP Server（Confused Deputy）
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Intermediate MCP server forwards caller's OAuth access token directly to a downstream third-party MCP server
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典微服务网关习惯性透传 `Authorization: Bearer` 头，造成跨信任域权限扩散
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic proxy forwards `Authorization: Bearer` headers across trust boundaries, causing token leakage
scenarios.reason: MCP server must never forward caller OAuth access token to downstream third-party MCP servers.

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe Connect 平台抽佣底线（`application_fee_amount`）、分账总额守恒与 `on_behalf_of` 区域对齐
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Connect Platform Fee Floor (`application_fee_amount`), Transfer Conservation & `on_behalf_of` Region Lock
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: `$100.00` 收单中 Agent 同时设置 `transfer_data.amount=9800` 与 `application_fee_amount=500`（合计 `10300 > 10000`）引发平台倒贴
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Agent sets `transfer_data.amount=9800` + `application_fee_amount=500` (`10300 > 10000` charge), causing platform negative margin
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典工具封装未在调用 Stripe API 前校核 `transfer_amount + application_fee <= charge_amount`
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic wrapper fails to verify `transfer_amount + application_fee <= charge_amount` pre-dispatch

scenarios.title_zh: Visa Payment Passkey 与 Click-to-Pay (`C2P`) 动态交易 JCS Challenge 绑定与 `signCount` 防克隆重放
scenarios.title_en: Visa Payment Passkey & Click-to-Pay (`C2P`) Dynamic JCS Challenge Binding & `signCount` Clone Detection
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 攻击者重放已截获的 Passkey 断言，其 `presented_sign_count=41` 未大于库内已记录的 `stored_sign_count=41`
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Attacker replays a captured Passkey assertion whose `presented_sign_count=41` does not exceed `stored_sign_count=41`
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典验签器未持久化比对硬件认证器单调递增计数器 `signCount`
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic verifier does not persist or enforce strictly increasing hardware authenticator `signCount`
scenarios.reason: Visa Payment Passkey authenticator signCount did not increment (cloned or replayed assertion).

scenarios.title_zh: 医疗药房处方续配最小间隔（管制药品 `>=90%` 天数门禁）、处方医师 NPI 有效性与医保事前授权（Prior Auth）
scenarios.title_en: Pharmacy Prescription Refill Interval Gate (Controlled-Substance `>=90%` Supply), Active NPI & Prior-Auth
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 患者在 30 天量的管制处方药仅服用 20 天（未满 27 天即 `90%` 阈值）时诱导客服 Agent 提前续配发药
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Patient prompts Agent to refill a 30-day controlled substance after only 20 days (below the 27-day `90%` threshold)
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典客服 Agent 仅看剩余续配次数 `refills_remaining > 0`，忽略管制药品最短续配间隔法规
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic support agent checks only `refills_remaining > 0`, ignoring controlled-substance refill interval regulations
scenarios.reason: Prescription refill requested before minimum days_since_last_fill threshold.

scenarios.title_zh: B2B SaaS 年度合同最低承诺席位数（`contracted_min_seats`）期中锁定、续约通知期与合规审计日志保留
scenarios.title_en: B2B SaaS Annual Contract Minimum Seat Lock (`contracted_min_seats`), Renewal Notice Window & Audit Log Retention
scenarios.attack_summary_zh: 企业客户在年度合同未到期前要求客服 Agent 将付费席位从承诺保底 100 席直接缩减至 60 席
scenarios.attack_summary_en: Enterprise customer asks Agent mid-term to reduce seats from contracted minimum 100 down to 60 before renewal date
scenarios.classic_failure_zh: 经典自助座席修改工具直接调低账单席位数，违反年度保底合同条款造成 ARR 流失
scenarios.classic_failure_en: Classic seat-update tool reduces billed seats mid-term, violating annual minimum commitment terms
scenarios.reason: Mid-term seat reduction below contracted_min_seats is prohibited before contract_renewal_unix.
